title: Apricot Slice
description: A crumbly traybake made with fresh apricots blended with coconut oil and topped with toasted flaked almonds.
steps: Preheat the oven to 195°C/175°C fan. Line a 25cm x 18cm baking tray with greaseproof paper.
Chop the apricots into tiny pieces. Transfer to a food processor, add the coconut oil and blitz to a rough purée.
Add three-quarters of the flaked almonds and pulse several times to combine.
Tip the mixture into the baking tray, flatten down with the back of a spoon. Scatter remaining almonds over the top.
Bake for 30–35 minutes until the almonds on top turn brown. Leave to cool completely before cutting into squares.
notes: Makes 16 pieces. Keeps for a week in an airtight tin.
